args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. All three final checks (rigid-body invariance, closure, plane sections) pass on every run. No run kept a remedy, had a roll-back or used the width-free ratio.
Flagged (2), reason summary_outlier: r01 and r08.
Cleared (6): r02, r03, r04, r05, r06 and r07. All their summaries are close to the batch (|z| ≤ 1.42).
What r01 and r08 have in common: their strain-rate profile has a different shape. The largest flank difference is negative (-0.47 vs a median of 0.55 %/h) and sits close to the tip (84 vs 316 µm, z -5.05). That points to a different curvature-rate pattern, not just a faster root. Their centre REGR peak is about twice the median (0.72 vs 0.37 %/h). The peak position (768 µm) and growth-zone length (42 µm) are like the batch, so the high peak alone would only mean a faster root.
Note: the summaries are identical within three groups: r01 = r08, r02 = r04 = r07, and r03 = r05 = r06. You may want to confirm these runs are separate measurements and not copies.
